Role & responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy production-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Build and manage multi-agent systems including planner, retriever, reasoning, and guardrail agents.
Design end-to-end RAG pipelines from data ingestion to retrieval and generation.
Develop agent orchestration workflows using LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain, or similar frameworks.
Optimize LLM applications for latency, accuracy, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Implement Responsible AI practices including hallucination mitigation, prompt injection defense, and output validation.
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Integrate AI models with enterprise applications and APIs.
Troubleshoot, monitor, and continuously improve AI systems in production environments.
Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to AI best practices.



Preferred candidate profile

4 to 6 years of overall experience with strong Python development expertise.
Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in GenAI, Agentic AI, or LLM-based applications.
Proven experience building real-world AI systems (not POCs or demos).
Strong understanding of RAG architecture, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval strategies.
Experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain, AutoGen, or similar agent frameworks.
Knowledge of SQL and Data Analysis is highly preferred.
Strong system design and problem-solving skills.
Ability to explain AI architecture, design decisions, challenges, and optimization strategies.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is an advantage.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
